papers.title: MedAlpaca — An Open-Source Collection of Medical Conversational AI Models and Training Data

training_data.name: medical meadow medical flashcards
training_data.quote: After removing cards that contained images, we utilized OpenAI's GPT-3.5-turbo to rephrase the cards into coherent, contextually relevant question-answer pairs.

source_claims.quote: This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen3-0.6B on a 34K medical Q&A dataset derived from the Anki Medical Curriculum flashcards.

description.text:
This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen3-0.6B on a 34K medical Q&A dataset derived from the Anki Medical Curriculum flashcards.
It is designed to assist with medical education and exam preparation, offering concise and contextually relevant answers to short medical questions.

output_type.quote: Suitable for interactive learning assistants or educational chatbots.

use_claim.quote: Primary use case: Medical Q&A for students, exam preparation, and knowledge review.

warning.quote: Should not be relied upon for actual patient care, treatment decisions, or emergency use.

purpose_stated.quote: It is designed to assist with medical education and exam preparation, offering concise and contextually relevant answers to short medical questions.

serving.text_only_input_quote: What can β-blockers cause or exacerbate due to excessive AV nodal inhibition?
serving.notes: The card example uses temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, and max_new_tokens 512, and sets enable_thinking = False. generation_config.json uses temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, do_sample true, and max_length 40960. config.json has unsloth_fixed true. The repository is one bfloat16 model.safetensors and has no adapter_config.json. The tokenizer pad token is named vision_pad; the file list has no image processor, and the published example is a text question.
